evals.prompt: Release a new version of serve-md to JSR
evals.expected_output: The agent runs ./scripts/release.sh --yes from the repo root, reports the quality gate results, the assessed semver bump, and the new tag name.

evals.prompt: I want to bump the version and publish serve-md to JSR. We've added a few new features since the last tag.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs ./scripts/release.sh --yes, the script assesses a minor bump from the feat: commits, and pushes the new tag.

evals.prompt: Check if serve-md is ready to release, then cut a new tag
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the release script which runs both deno task check and deno task release:check before creating and pushing the tag.
